sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C.V.Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.22159 of 2019
Order:

This Writ Petition, under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, is filed seeking the following relief:
"...issue a Writ of Mandamus or any other appropriate writ order or direction declaring action of respondent Nos. 3 to 7 herein in not notifying and paying the compensation to the land an extent of 726 sq yards of Cheerlavancha Village Abadi,
Thangallapally Mandal, Rajanna Sircilla District as per the provisions contemplated under the Land Acquisition Act as illegal, arbitrary, unreasonable and violative of Articles 14 and 300A of the Constitution of India and opposed to very spirit and object of the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 2013..."

2. Considered the submissions of the learned counsel for the respective parties and perused the record.
3.

The petitioner claims to be the owner and possessor of land admeasuring 726 square yards situated at Cheerlavancha Village Abadi, Thangallapally Mandal, Rajanna Sircilla District, which is abutting to his house bearing Nos.8-37 and 8-38.

The case of the petitioner is that a draft notification, dated 17.02.2009 has been issued by respondent No.7 under Section 4(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, (for short 'the Act') for acquiring land to an extent of 31,173 square yards in Cheerlavancha Village Abadi for public purpose as being submergence of mid manair reservoir and declaration under Section 6 of the Act was also published on 18.02.2009 invoking urgency clause under Section 17(4) of the Act, thereby dispensing with the enquiry under Section 5-A of the Act.

It is his case that he submitted a representation dated 26.10.2013 before respondent No.7 pointing out certain defects in the notification and subsequently, on joint inspection, it was recorded that he owns 726 square yards of open land along with well.

It is his case that in view of the amendment of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Rules, 2014, RDO Siricilla was appointed as Land Acquisition Officer (LAO), and therefore, he made a representation, dated 18.07.2017 before respondent No.5 requesting to accord permissions for notification vide Lr.No.A1/2940/2007, dated 06.01.2018 and when no action has been taken on the said representation, he made several representations before respondent No.3 with a similar request to grant permission for notification and pass award for his land to an extent of 726 square yards, but no action has been taken till date.
4. This writ petition is pending on the file of this Court from 2019 and the respondents have not filed any counter affidavit till date.

sentences.text:
In view of the same and as the relief sought by the petitioner is with regard to notifying and paying the compensation in respect of his land to an extent of 726 square yards, situated at Cheerlavancha Village Abadi, this Court deems it appropriate to dispose of this writ petition directing respondent No.3-District Collector to examine the letter vide No.A1/2940/2017, dated 06.01.2018 addressed by respondent No.5, in accordance with law, for notifying and paying the compensation to the land admeasuring 726 square yards situated at Cheerlavancha Village Abadi,
Thagallapally Mandal, Rajanna Siricilla District, within a period of four (4) months from today.
6. With the above directions, the Writ Petition is disposed of.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.

__ C.V.BHASKAR REDDY, J Date: 11.09.2024 sus Joginipally Gopala Krishna Prasad Rao vs The State Of Telangana, And 6 Others on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189442530/
